source: ABISS final benchmark run on BIRD dev, 11 Nov 2026

question.nlq: Could you tell me which superheroes from my preferred publisher have an intelligence attribute value that exceeds the average intelligence of heroes sharing my second-favorite alignment?

meanings.hidden_knowledge: The first user's preferred publisher is DC Comics and their second-favorite alignment is Neutral
meanings.gt_sql:
SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute at ON ha.attribute_id = at.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics'
  AND at.attribute_name = 'Intelligence'
  AND ha.attribute_value > (
      SELECT AVG(ha2.attribute_value)
      FROM hero_attribute ha2
      JOIN superhero s2 ON ha2.hero_id = s2.id
      JOIN alignment a2 ON s2.alignment_id = a2.id
      JOIN attribute at2 ON ha2.attribute_id = at2.id
      WHERE a2.alignment = 'Neutral'
        AND at2.attribute_name = 'Intelligence'
  )

meanings.hidden_knowledge: The second user's preferred publisher is Dark Horse Comics and their second-favorite alignment is Bad
